props.name: variant
props.description: Visual layout variant matching Figma `Property 1`. - `'default'` — header + optional media + content (Figma Default) - `'slim'` — header + content only; `media` is ignored (Figma Slim) Defaults to `'default'`. Existing call sites that omit `media` continue to render a media-less default card (backward compatible). Prefer `variant="slim"` when you want the Slim contract explicitly. Default "default", from the component source.

props.name: header
props.description: A plain string header is wrapped in Text. Declared: Content rendered in the header slot at the top of the card (e.g. a brand logo). Sits above the media slot, padded with `card/content/padding/*`. `false`, `''` and `null` hide the slot.

props.name: media
props.description: Media slot content (e.g. `<Image />`). Wrapped in a container that respects `mediaAspectRatio`. Ignored when `variant="slim"`. `false`, `''` and `null` hide the slot.

props.name: modes
props.description: The card doesn't read the app's theme: its modes come from this prop or from a Coin stack it is placed in. Declared: Modes object for token resolution. Cascades into all slots.

props.name: mediaAspectRatio
props.description: Aspect ratio for the media slot container. Defaults to the Figma Ratio 154/116 (~1.328). Default 1.3276 (154 / 116), from the component source.

props.name: style
props.description: Style overrides for the card container.

props.name: onPress
props.description: A pressable card dims to opacity 0.92 on hover and 0.8 while pressed (mouse and Space), and shows a 1 px #0c0d10 focus outline at offset 2, which also shows after a mouse click until blur. Declared: Press handler for the whole card. When set, the card becomes pressable (`Pressable` + `accessibilityRole="button"`).

props.name: disabled
props.description: With onPress: opacity 0.5, disabled and aria-disabled, tabindex -1, skipped by Tab, no hover or press change. Without onPress it does nothing. Declared: Disable interaction when `onPress` is set.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Without onPress it makes the card a group with that name on the web; with onPress it names the button. Declared: Accessibility label forwarded to the root.

props.name: ...CardBaseProps
props.description: Inherited React Native props the component also accepts. They are not part of the design contract and no guide documents them.

props.name: Card.Title
props.description: 16 px, weight 900, line height 20 (the 18 px token raised to fit the type); clamps at 3 lines, and its numberOfLines changes that (0 removes the clamp). Not a heading. Declared: A static sub-component of Card. Its own props: children, style, modes, numberOfLines.

props.name: Card.SupportText
props.description: 12 px on 16 px lines, weight 400, with no line limit unless numberOfLines sets one. Not a heading. Declared: A static sub-component of Card. Its own props: children, style, modes, numberOfLines.

modes.name: AppearanceBrand
modes.description: Sets the card's fill. With no modes, or Color Mode Light only, the fill is Neutral white (#ffffff); AppearanceBrand Primary, on the card or from a VStack, gives cream #fef4e5. Declared: A token collection Card reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.description: A token collection Card reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

slots.name: header
slots.description: Content rendered in the header slot at the top of the card (e.g. a brand logo). Sits above the media slot, padded with `card/content/padding/*`. `false`, `''` and `null` hide the slot.

slots.name: media
slots.description: Media slot content (e.g. `<Image />`). Wrapped in a container that respects `mediaAspectRatio`. Ignored when `variant="slim"`. `false`, `''` and `null` hide the slot.

events.name: onPress
events.description: Press handler for the whole card. When set, the card becomes pressable (`Pressable` + `accessibilityRole="button"`).

gaps.text: Figma draws Default and Slim at 200 px with fixed heights; in code the card hugs its content.
Card.Title's line height is 20 px in code and 18 px in Figma.
Figma has no header switch on Slim; code accepts a header there.
